title: 300 km/h train, wheelchair door 780 mm
why: The 1000 mm rule needs a speed below 250 km/h, but the general 800 mm rule still applies to the wheelchair door.

exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.required: ≥ 800 mm (the 1000 mm rule does not apply at 300 km/h)
exterior_doors.wheelchair_door_clear_wid.rationale: 4.2.2.3.2(2) is for 'a design speed lower than 250 km/h': not met. 4.2.2.3.2(1) covers 'all exterior passenger doorways': 780 < 800.
